question.worked_solution:
Solving $x+y+z=0$ for $z,$ we get $z=-x-y.$ Therefore, any vector from $\text{Ker}(T)$ can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ -x-y\end{aligned}]=x{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{1}}+y{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{v}_{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$

This means that $\text{Ker}(T)=\text{Span}{{v}_{1},{v}_{2}}.$ Therefore, $\text{nullity}(T)=2.$ 

Finally, according the rank-nullity theorem, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(T) & =3-\text{nullity}(T) \\  & =3-2 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
